title: hello
description: The first message the extension's service worker sends on the bridge WebSocket. The bridge accepts only its own protocol version.

lastSeq.description: The last event-log sequence the worker has seen; 0 asks for a fresh snapshot.

version.description: The extension's version (X.Y.Z), recorded by the bridge for tweak claim's warnings.

reloadedFor.description: The version the worker last reloaded itself for, while its own still differs; empty when it hasn't. Until it equals the bridge's version, the extension is still updating, not loaded from another folder. An older extension leaves it out.
